content:
ryan_pm: Heads-up 1: PolarisEdge B1 preview cleared. NDA complete but legal wants a narrow telemetry window. We need an ops + marketplace playbook before hardware arrives. ETA shipping Tue. @maria.partners can you run handoff?

maria.partners: on it. will assemble runbook (shipping manifest, lab checklist, contacts). Sam, please confirm whether the devices come with the vendor KMS image and if there's a SOC-level debug snapshot we should avoid collecting.

sam_polaris: Sam from Polaris. Devices ship with vendor KMS enabled by default; debug snapshot can be disabled. We'll include a checkbox in the manifest for debug logs. Firmware = 2.4.1-beta-rc3. Ships with rackmount brackets + PDUs (6 outlet).

kevin_ml: for benchmarks: we'll run two passes: performance (throughput/latency) and quality (sample prompts). request HF-safe model artifacts + tokenizer. telemetry needed: per-token latency, GPU power, and KV cache evictions.

dugan_sre: lab constraints: need 2U per device, recommend A/C setpoint 20-22C for thermal stability test. advise a 6-hour soak after power-on. we also need serial->asset tag CSV.

anya_legal: drafting a short addendum: telemetry retention = 30 days, export control clause for firmware traces, marketing asset approvals flow. will send for signature within 24h.

maria.partners: Sam, can you provide a marketplace one-liner + logo SVG and confirm allowed screenshots? Legal needs these for the blurb. Also confirm joint announcement cadence (we prefer no public statement during preview).

sam_polaris: we'll provide logo + 2-line blurb. No public announcement during preview window; internal co-marketing ok with approval. Screenshots need to be anonymized (no IPs/serials).

kevin_ml: proposed bench config (Redwood eval harness v2):
```json
{
  "suite": "polaris_b1_preview",
  "model": "redwood-test-3b",
  "seq": 1024,
  "batch": 4,
  "soak_hours": 6,
  "telemetry": ["token_latency_ms","gpu_power_w","kv_evictions"]
}
```

kevin_ml: Acceptance: p99 latency < 150ms at seq1024 batch<=4; sustained throughput >= 92% of ref; no more than 1 restart in 6h soak.

dugan_sre: I'll reserve the rack Tue 08:00-14:00 for burn-in + perf runs. tag me if you need emergency power cutoff.

bench-bot: scheduled run -> id 2026-PE-B1-PREVIEW-01. Command: `./rbench --suite polaris_b1_preview --host 10.21.7.44` :rocket:

maria.partners: I'll publish the runbook to the shared folder tonight and ping the group. Action list: Maria = runbook, Kevin = bench harness + prompts, Anya = addendum, Dugan = rack reserve, Sam = upload artifacts/logo.

ryan_pm: great. quick reminder: no public PR or tweet until post-preview signoff. check-in Fri AM. :thumbsup:
